# Salaf

> Salaf is a public platform for accessing beneficial Islamic knowledge and resources.

The current production site is https://manhaji-salaf.vercel.app/. The planned future domain is https://salaf.com/ after the domain is purchased, connected to Vercel, and verified. Until that migration is complete, agents should treat the Vercel domain as canonical.

## Public resources

Home: https://manhaji-salaf.vercel.app/

Explore: https://manhaji-salaf.vercel.app/explore

Islamic lectures and videos: https://manhaji-salaf.vercel.app/videos

Audio lessons: https://manhaji-salaf.vercel.app/audio

Articles: https://manhaji-salaf.vercel.app/articles

Public gallery: https://manhaji-salaf.vercel.app/gallery

Support and public campaigns: https://manhaji-salaf.vercel.app/donate

Privacy policy: https://manhaji-salaf.vercel.app/privacy-policy

Terms of service: https://manhaji-salaf.vercel.app/terms-of-service

## Discovery and access

The canonical public discovery feed is https://manhaji-salaf.vercel.app/sitemap.xml. Crawl directives are available at https://manhaji-salaf.vercel.app/robots.txt. Article detail URLs use the format https://manhaji-salaf.vercel.app/articles/{article-id} when an article is publicly available. Dynamic records are sourced from the application’s public Firestore content and should not be inferred when unavailable.

## Restricted resources

Profiles, notifications, user questions, administration, authentication, and user-generated private data are restricted and are not public crawl targets.
